title: the bundle check reads measured model files by their hash
note: basis 'shown' means shown by the card's local runs; CI was not run by the card.

findings.claim: in a models folder, the measured record let only binary content of no known kind through by hash; its weights file was still listed as not terminology by its extension and its text files were read; now every file a measured record lists (embedder/, and the serving record's judge and verifier folders) passes only on its recorded sha256 and is not read

make_bundle.sh with a real models folder holding the embedder's real tokenizer file was not run: the file was not fetched, so the pass of a real site bundle's vocabulary check is shown on synthetic bytes only

the bundle check refused a verifier model folder's recipe.yaml as YAML that does not parse (the bench, integrator comment 7085061627); the file is listed in that model's measured record (the serving record under deploy/measured/), so it is now hash-checked, not parsed; why the bench's copy does not parse is not shown, as the file is not in the repository
